title: AttributeError: 'AssAttr' object has no attribute 'name'
body:
Originally reported by: **Anonymous**

---

With the following snippet:

```
#!python

class MyClass(object):
        def __new__(cls):
                singl = cls.__dict__.get("__singl__")
                if singl is None:
                        cls.__singl__ = singl = MyClass.__new__(cls)
                return singl
```

the following error occurs:

```
#!

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/bin/pyreverse", line 9, in <module>
    load_entry_point('pylint==1.2.1', 'console_scripts', 'pyreverse')()

    Run(sys.argv[1:])
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pylint/pyreverse/main.py", line 98, in __init__
    sys.exit(self.run(args))
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pylint/pyreverse/main.py", line 112, in run
    diadefs = handler.get_diadefs(project, linker)
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pylint/pyreverse/diadefslib.py", line 232, in get_diadefs
    diagram.extract_relationships()
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pylint/pyreverse/diagrams.py", line 150, in extract_relationships
    obj.methods = self.get_methods(node)
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pylint/pyreverse/diagrams.py", line 93, in get_methods
    return [m for m in sorted(node.values(), key=lambda n: n.name)
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pylint/pyreverse/diagrams.py", line 93, in <lambda>
    return [m for m in sorted(node.values(), key=lambda n: n.name)
AttributeError: 'AssAttr' object has no attribute 'name'
```

I tested it on the latest pyreverse and astroid tips.
